findings.required_producer_contract: P03 must replace the storage-visible sender capability with an unlinkable, authenticated deposit authorization.
P03 must provide recipient-private addressing whose storage-visible value is not a raw Session ID.
P03 must define an opaque deposit capability and a distinct opaque retrieval capability.
P03 must prevent a storage observer from using a stable client-generated identifier across independent transport attempts.

findings.evidence: No opaque deposit capability exists in the current producer contract.
findings.required_producer_contract: P03 must expose a versioned opaque deposit capability with expiry, replay bounds and authenticated failure semantics.

findings.evidence: Current retrieval authenticates with the raw account public key.
findings.required_producer_contract: P03 must expose a versioned opaque retrieval capability separated from deposit authorization.
P03/P06 must replace raw account subscription keys with unlinkable rotating push handles.

findings.evidence: Current subscription binds a raw account to a provider token; no rotating handle contract exists.
findings.required_producer_contract: P03/P06 must define handle rotation, overlap, revocation, retry and account-switch unlinkability.
